pass_max_days.description: Maximum number of days a password may be used before it must be changed. Set to 0 to disable expiration.

pass_min_days.description: Minimum number of days between password changes. Prevents immediate password re-use.

pass_warn_age.description: Number of days before password expiration to warn the user.

pass_min_len.description: Minimum password length. Values < 4 are generally unsafe; modern systems recommend ≥ 8.

uid_min.description: First regular user UID (non-system accounts). System accounts get UIDs below this.

uid_max.description: Last regular user UID. User IDs beyond this may be reserved for special uses.

gid_min.description: First regular group GID (non-system groups). System groups get GIDs below this.

sys_uid_min.description: First system UID reserved for system accounts (e.g., services, daemons).

create_home.description: Automatically create a home directory for new users.

default_shell.description: Default login shell for new users.

umask.description: Default file creation mask (octal). Controls default permissions of newly created files.

pass_change_tries.description: Number of attempts to change a password (e.g., during initial login).

pass_always_warn.description: Always warn about password expiration, even if within the last 24 hours.

encrypt_method.description: Password hashing algorithm (SHA512, DES, MD5, or BCRYPT). SHA512 is recommended for security.

inactive.description: Number of days after password expires before account is locked. -1 disables locking.

usergroups_enab.description: If true, creates a group for the user with the same name as the user account.

login_lock_failed.description: Maximum number of failed login attempts before account lockout (0 = no limit).

login_lock_dur.description: Duration (seconds) of account lockout after too many failed attempts (0 = until admin unlock).

userdel_prefix.description: Prefix used by userdel to find user files (e.g., '/var/spool/mail' for mail).

mail_dir.description: Directory where user mailboxes are stored (used if CREATE_HOME=yes).

mail_file.description: Filename (relative to MAIL_DIR) for user mailbox (e.g., 'mail' → /var/mail/username).

env_hz.description: Additional environment variable 'HZ' (kernel tick rate); usually empty.

env_path.description: Default PATH for regular users (colon-separated list of directories).

name.description: Group name to add to new users' initial group list

groups.description: List of additional groups to assign to new users (in /etc/group notation).

group_umask.description: Umask applied to files created by new group members.
